43:214.en: 「I won't let you do as you please!」

43:239.en: 「At this range, I can do it!」

43:295.en: 「However many times it takes, I will!」

43:394.en: 「I won't let you rule the skies!」

43:429.en: 「The top dog's here! I'll crush you!」

43:769.en: 「I'll stop you before you even start!」

43:794.en: 「I won't give you time to counter!」

43:1010.en: 「I can't waste all my time on you!」

alternatives: You hit us, we hit back!
Hit us, and we'll hit back!
If you hit me, I'll hit back!
You hit me, so I'll hit you back!

43:1113.en: 「I won't go down without a fight!」

43:1219.en: 「I'll prove my skill to the captain!」

43:1254.en: 「Leave the finish to me, $$ミシェル$$!」

43:1407.en: 「Captain $$ガムリン$$! Leave this to me!」

43:1502.en: 「No ally will fall before my eyes...!」

43:1537.en: 「I won't let you make $$ランカ$$ cry!」

43:1566.en: 「I won't let you take $$ミシェル$$ down!」

43:1877.en: 「For now, I just have to hold out...!」

43:2202.en: 「I see it...! I can see your moves!」

43:2603.en: 「Do you think this is a game...?!」

43:2918.en: 「I can't let it end without acting!!」

43:2961.en: 「I won't give up...! I refuse to!!」

43:3000.en: 「I'm not dying in a place like this!!」

43:3043.en: 「I haven't flown the true sky yet...!」

43:3086.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?!」

43:3117.en: 「Damn! If it still moves, I'll fight!」

43:3603.en: 「I'll draw out all of its power!」

43:3834.en: 「I have to avoid the vital points...!」

43:3943.en: 「I won't listen to a word you say!」

43:4027.en: 「I won't lose, no matter who I face!」

43:4201.en: 「I won't lose a contest of speed!」

43:4236.en: 「I won't lag behind in aerial combat!」

43:4390.en: 「I'll reclaim what you took from us!」

43:4427.en: 「This is for the people\nyou made suffer!」

43:4550.en: 「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$!\nI'll settle things with you too!」

43:4607.en: 「I won't let you decide\nmy fate for me!」

43:4656.en: 「My dance is for my own future!」

43:4766.en: 「You don't have time to look away!」

43:5157.en: 「I can't let them take you down!」

43:5323.en: 「But the game has friends - you too.」

43:5398.en: 「I'll wait to fly Z3 with you again!」

43:5540.en: 「Beside you, I feel we're twin wings.」

43:5674.en: 「Just so you know, I'm a man!」

43:6111.en: 「We resist with all we have to live!\nThat's what it is to be human!」

43:6308.en: 「I'll save you, no matter what!\nThat's how I make this right!」

43:6437.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$...!\nWe're taking Earth back!」

43:6486.en: 「It's the Empire! I'll go all out!」

43:6554.en: 「I won't let you use $$スフィア$$ power...!」

43:6696.en: 「As if a battleship could keep up\nwith our mobility!」

43:6782.en: 「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$!\nIf I take this one down...!」

43:6888.en: 「I won't listen to your ominous talk!」

43:6927.en: 「$$アサキム$$!\nYour darkness won't swallow me!」

43:7011.en: 「You're no emissaries of God!\nYou're the enemy of all humanity!」

43:7070.en: 「If you take the freedom of the sky,\nI'll fight with everything I have!」

43:7127.en: 「Humanity atones for its own sins!\nWe don't need your hand!」

43:7186.en: 「I won't be wiped out for fun!」

43:7305.en: 「I'll teach you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nTrue joy is loving people!」

43:7372.en: 「My dance, carrying my feelings, will\ncut through the world you create!」

43:7429.en: 「Our business is with the $$御使い$$s!\nStay out of it, small fry!」

43:7488.en: 「You don't understand your own power,\nyou deluded fools!」

43:7626.en: 「Get a grip, $$ブレラ$$!\nDon't misjudge your opponent!」

43:7753.en: 「It all comes down to one shot!」

43:7852.en: 「I'll fly, even through a sky at war!」

43:7895.en: 「All I ever do is fly flat out!」

43:7930.en: 「I'll fly until this fight is over!」

43:8035.en: 「They're being controlled through\nthe $$バジュラ$$ Queen...?! Damn!」

43:8102.en: 「If I destroy the $$インプラント$$ rounds!」

43:8135.en: 「All right, found it...!\nI'll set you free now!」

43:8292.en: 「$$ブレラ$$, take back your true heart!」

43:8335.en: 「I won't let you have your way with\nthe galaxy or the $$バジュラ$$!」

43:8419.en: 「If I could just free the\n$$バジュラ$$ Queen somehow...!」

43:8520.en: 「'Feel it in your gut and move'...\nYou're just like the $$バジュラ$$...!」

43:8684.en: 「I'll defy any fate I don't like!」

43:8894.en: 「You won't take our world\nor our sky!」

43:9143.en: 「I can do this! I'm a pilot!」

43:9651.en: 「We're not doing this for fun either!」

43:9821.en: 「$$スカル$$ 4 to $$クォーター$$. I'll take it!」

43:9899.en: 「$$アンタレス$$ 1, thanks for the help!」

43:10132.en: 「I won't let you take the $$クォーター$$!」

43:10200.en: 「$$アンタレス$$ 1, now, while you can!」

43:10229.en: 「$$ブレラ$$, what the hell are you doing?!」

43:10283.en: 「Damn! What the hell is going on...?!」

43:10318.en: 「Do I have to let it go?!」

43:10446.en: 「You dare make a fool of me...!」

43:10605.en: 「I've got to master the new model...!」

43:10648.en: 「Ngh! Hold on, I'll save you now...!」

43:10714.en: 「Is the fusion with the $$バジュラ$$ Queen\nnot complete yet...?!」

43:10769.en: 「A little longer...\nIf I can just hold out a bit longer!」

43:10841.en: 「If I can use the Pinpoint Barrier!」

43:11093.en: 「Checking all systems... I can go on!」
alternatives: Systems check... I can still fight!

43:11688.en: 「Gah! We have to deal with those\n$$インプラント$$ rounds fast, or we'll...!」

43:11798.en: 「Until we get our feelings\nthrough to the $$バジュラ$$...!」

43:11847.en: 「Manipulating the $$バジュラ$$ Queen\nas you please, damn you!」

43:11898.en: 「The attacks won't let up...!\nIs the operation going to fail...?!」

43:12029.en: 「Sorry I can't return your feelings. Thank you.」

43:12105.en: 「It may be a little late, but...」
